ios.desc:
Stop scrolling. Start living. Recode is the only screen time app that requires you to physically scan a QR code or barcode to unlock your blocked apps. No easy bypass. No cheating. Just real accountability.

How it works:
   1. Choose which apps to block and set your schedule.
   2. Pick any QR code or barcode as your unlock key — a book on your shelf, a code at your desk, anything.
   3. When you want to unblock, you have to physically go scan it. That friction is what makes Recode work.

Why it's different:
Other screen time apps let you bypass limits with a single tap. Recode doesn't. The physical requirement of scanning a code creates real resistance between you and your distracting apps. You can't cheat from the couch.

Track your progress with Streaks:
Build a daily streak by keeping your break time under 30 minutes. Watch your calendar fill with green as you take back control of your habits.

Built from personal experience:
I built Recode because I was losing myself in endless scrolling — distracted all day, drained at night, ashamed of how little I got done. Even in its demo version, the simple act of requiring a scan to unblock completely shifted my habits. Knowing I couldn't unblock until I got home kept me off my phone. Over time, I reclaimed focus, confidence, and the satisfaction of being productive.

Take control of your time. Download Recode today.

Available subscription options:
Recode Pro – Monthly or Annual auto-renewable subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: 18yo first iOS app: blocks distracting apps and unlocks with QR/barcode

quotes.text:
I built Recode because I realized I was spending 8-10 hours a day on my phone pretty consistently. I tried other screen time apps but I found them too easy to bypass and end my blocks whenever I wanted to use an app.

My solution was to build an app blocker app that makes users have to scan a physical QR/barcode to take a break from their app blocks. This helped me be able to get my screen time down to just a few hours everyday since I didn't want to physically get up and go across the house to get my barcode.

Anyways, since it worked for me I felt like sharing it.

App store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/recode-screen-time-control/id6752352978
